name: rtl-conformity
description: Right-to-left conformity for Hebrew, Arabic, Farsi and Urdu across every surface an agent writes to: email (Gmail, Resend), Google Docs, Sheets, Slides and Drive, calendar events, and generated files (Word, PDF, Excel, CSV, charts). Explicit direction, isolated numbers and dates, Israeli formatting conventions, and read-back checks for failures that never raise an error. Instruction-only; works in Claude and ChatGPT.
